I answered Hollis in a thread on their #central-random message: the ticket is **#88412**.

That number comes from #central-team. On Jul 2, 2025, Tobias raised it as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging froze on the BOL barcode scan when a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest. In the same thread, Tobias first called the account "Tansley Packaging" and later confirmed #88412 is Tansleigh Packaging.

Posting it in #central-random is fine. Both channels have the same members (Hollis, Priyanka, Tobias), and a ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure.

I couldn't find any ticket files for Tansleigh in the shared files, so I haven't checked whether the ticket is still open.
